svg.aria-label: Original history and instrument schematic. A illustrates wavelength separation in the 1860 analysis; colours and geometry are explanatory. B illustrates the calcium suppression problem discussed in 1964; bar heights are conceptual. C shows droplet selection, drainage, concentric torch, RF coil and alternative axial/radial viewing paths; dimensions are not to scale.
